title: David Says Sorry
traveler_why: Willow is the Traveler with the warm heart, and tonight King David’s heart breaks and he says I have sinned: Willow gives back her little brother’s crayon, says sorry, and asks him to color with her.
traveler_about: Willow fits tonight because a warm heart knows how to say sorry. In Willow’s world today: Willow grabs the last purple crayon from her little brother, and he starts to cry. At first she holds on tight. Then she sees his sad face, and her own heart feels sad too. Willow kneels down, gives the crayon back, and says, “I’m sorry. Do you want to color together?” He wipes his eyes and nods. Just like King David, Willow learned that a real sorry comes from the heart and helps make things right.
